summary: Tested admin permissions for fixed expenses module. RESULT: Admin CAN create, view, edit, and delete fixed expenses. Both backend API and frontend UI are working correctly. The reported issue could not be reproduced.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend permissions for fixed-expenses are correctly implemented using role-based checks (admin and superadmin)
Frontend GastosFijos.js does not restrict the 'Nuevo Gasto Fijo' button based on role - it's visible to all authenticated users who can access the page
The only role-specific restriction in frontend is the 'Generar Ahora' button which is only visible to superadmin (line 239)
seed_data_creation: Test fixed expense 'TEST_Gasto_Admin_UI' was created and deleted during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin permissions for fixed expenses module verified working. Backend endpoints (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE /api/fixed-expenses) all allow admin role. Frontend shows 'Nuevo Gasto Fijo' button and allows full CRUD operations for admin users.
